leaf.target: Cargo Source Replacement directory-source local completeness requirements under previously established frozen/offline use-time guard
observations: Cargo documents source replacement as redirecting registry or git dependency communication to another source, including an exact local copy.
Cargo states a core assumption that source code is exactly the same between original and replacement sources and that the replacement may not contain crates absent from the original source.
A directory source is a local filesystem source containing unpacked crate source directories and is primarily managed by cargo vendor.

Each crate in a directory source has an associated .cargo-checksum.json metadata file intended to protect against accidental modifications; the page explicitly says this is not a security mechanism against malicious changes.
leaf.result: The official Source Replacement page documents structural completeness expectations for a directory source: local unpacked crate source plus per-crate .cargo-checksum.json, under an exact-source replacement assumption. Combined only with the prior own-state finding that --frozen enforces offline plus locked behavior, network fallback is excluded at use time. However, this exact page does not document the runtime behavior for missing, unparsable, or content-mismatched checksum metadata, so failure-closed rejection of incomplete or invalid local material is not yet established by this leaf.
